description: Interactive map with tile, UDF and SQL layers.

basemap.description: Mapbox style URL (e.g. "mapbox://styles/mapbox/dark-v11", "mapbox://styles/mapbox/light-v11", "mapbox://styles/mapbox/satellite-streets-v12") or "blank" for a plain background. Omit it so the map follows the app light/dark theme; when the viewer picks a basemap in the switcher it is written into this prop, so only set it when a fixed basemap is wanted.

centerLng.description: Map centre longitude (defaults to -98). Setting centerLng or centerLat turns auto-fit off unless autoFit is set explicitly.

centerLat.description: Map centre latitude (defaults to 39.5). Setting centerLng or centerLat turns auto-fit off unless autoFit is set explicitly.

zoom.description: Initial zoom level; only used when auto-fit is off.

autoFit.description: Fly to the loaded data once on first load: inline GeoJSON plus every visible udf / sql row layer. Defaults to true, or false when centerLng/centerLat is set (an explicit camera wins). Later pans, re-runs and basemap switches leave the camera alone, and a camera the viewer left behind wins. Tile layers never report bounds. When off the map opens at centerLng/centerLat/zoom.

type.description: Layer type. Omit it to detect from the data: an image → raster (tiles from a tile UDF, else one image placed at the bounds the run returned or was sent), an H3 cell column → h3, start/end lat-lng pairs → arc, one lat-lng pair → scatterplot, a geometry column → geojson. The detected type and columns are written into this config once known. All types render through deck.gl. geojson: polygons/lines/points from inline data, sql or udf rows (deck-geojson is an alias of geojson; prefer geojson). h3: hexagons from h3Column. scatterplot: point circles. heatmap: point density. arc: source→target arcs. raster: tiles from tileUrl or a udf with tile: true, else a single image from a udf. mvt: tiles from tileUrl, or from udf with tile: true. fused-hex: H3 tiles queried from a Fused server's ERA5, gridMET or /h3/query endpoints (see source); it is never detected, so set it explicitly.

tileUrl.description: Tile URL template with {x}/{y}/{z} placeholders (mvt, raster, tiled h3)

minZoom.description: Minimum zoom for tiled layers (mvt, raster, tiled h3)

maxZoom.description: Maximum zoom for tiled layers (mvt, raster, tiled h3)

zoomOffset.description: Zoom offset for tiled layers (useful for hex tile generalization)

maxRequests.description: Maximum parallel tile requests for tiled layers

autoRetry.description: Retry failed tiles automatically: a few fetch attempts on transient errors, and a refetch when a failed tile scrolls back into view. Default true. Set false to make a tile fail after one attempt and stay failed until Retry.

bounds.description: Lock a udf tile layer (tile: true) drawn as geojson or deck-geojson to these bounds [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat]: the UDF runs once with bounds passed as a parameter (a JSON string "[w, s, e, n]", like the legacy single-viewport run) and the result renders as one static layer, with no per-tile runs and no refetch on pan or zoom. Ignored by other layers: other types (h3, scatterplot, arc, heatmap, raster, mvt) keep their tiles.

sourceLayer.description: Source layer name for MVT tiles (defaults to 'default')

udf.description: UDF placeholder, e.g. {{my_udf}} or {{my_udf?param=value}}. The UDF is run directly (no share token needed) and re-run when it changes: the whole result as rows for geojson/deck layers, or per tile when tile is true. Combine with sql to query the result. Mutually exclusive with tileUrl.

tile.description: With udf: run the UDF per XYZ tile (raster → PNG bitmaps, h3 → hexagons, geojson → vector features). Required when type is mvt and the source is a udf. Without it a raster udf layer runs once and draws one image at the bounds the run returned (`image, bounds`) or was sent (the map view at the time of the run, for a UDF with a bounds parameter; moving the map later does not run it again). Tiled layers never auto-fit and ignore the whole-result size limit.

sql.description: DuckDB SQL query with {{udf_name}} placeholders. Rows are converted to GeoJSON for rendering.

filters.description: Feature filters applied on the client: range filters on numeric properties, category filters on any property.

values.description: Values to keep; empty keeps every feature (no filtering)

geometryColumn.description: Column containing the geometry: GeoJSON strings (use ST_AsGeoJSON in SQL), GeoJSON objects, or WKB blobs as stored by GeoDataFrame outputs. Defaults to 'geometry'.

h3Column.description: Column containing H3 hex indexes (h3 layer type). Auto-detected from common names (hex, h3, ...) when omitted.

latColumn.description: Column for latitude (point data). Defaults to 'lat'.

lngColumn.description: Column for longitude (point data). Defaults to 'lng'.

startLatColumn.description: Column for the arc start latitude (arc layer type).

startLngColumn.description: Column for the arc start longitude (arc layer type).

endLatColumn.description: Column for the arc end latitude (arc layer type).

endLngColumn.description: Column for the arc end longitude (arc layer type).

tooltip.description: Show tooltip on hover. true = all properties, string[] = specific properties.

legend.description: Show color legend for this layer. true = auto title, {title} = custom title. Only applies when fillColor or lineColor is data-driven.

source.description: fused-hex only: the server endpoint and query each XYZ tile's bbox is sent to.

endpoint.description: Bbox query endpoint on a Fused server: a full URL or a path relative to the current server root. Supported: /retrieve/era5/daily/bbox, /retrieve/era5/hourly/bbox, /retrieve/gridmet/bbox and /h3/query. Defaults to /h3/query when path is set.

path.description: Indexed dataset location, e.g. s3://bucket/indexed/data/. Sets the endpoint to /h3/query when none is given. Needs the layer's h3Column (the location's indexed space column). Not used by the retrieve endpoints, which serve a fixed dataset.

dateMin.description: Inclusive start of the time window (ISO date or datetime). Required for the retrieve endpoints.

dateMax.description: Inclusive end of the time window (ISO date or datetime). Required for the retrieve endpoints.

variables.description: Measurement columns to fetch. Defaults to the attributes the style, tooltip and filters name, or every column when none do.

reduce.description: How each hex's rows across the time window collapse to one value: latest (default) or first keep one time step; mean, min, max and sum aggregate every numeric variable and add count, date_min and date_max.

hour.description: Hourly datasets only: keep rows for this hour of the day before reducing.

timeColumn.description: Column holding each row's time, used to order rows for latest/first. Defaults to 'date' for the retrieve endpoints; set it for /h3/query datasets.

limit.description: Server row cap per tile request (the endpoint's `limit`)

maxRowGroups.description: Server row group cap per tile request (`max_row_groups`)

maxRanges.description: Retrieve endpoints only: cell ranges the bbox cover may use (`max_ranges`). Higher values cover each tile more tightly, so fewer rows outside it are read.

fillColor.description: Fill color (source colour for arc, weight attr for heatmap): [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] array, CSS string, or data-driven {type:"continuous", attr, domain?:[min,max], palette?, steps?, reverse?, nullColor?} | {type:"categorical", attr, colors?:{value:"#hex"}, palette?, nullColor?}. See the component description for palette names.

lineColor.description: Stroke color (target colour for arc): [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] array, CSS string, or the same data-driven {type:"continuous"|"categorical", attr, ...} object as fillColor.

coverage.description: H3 hex coverage 0-1 (1 = no gap, 0.8 = small gaps)

elevationAttr.description: Feature property to use for extrusion height

showBasemapSwitcher.description: Offer the dark/light/satellite basemap choice: the sidebar's Base map tab, or a floating toggle when showSidebar is false

showLegend.description: Show color legend for layers with data-driven colors

showLayerPanel.description: Show the floating layer panel for toggling visibility and opacity when showSidebar is false (the sidebar's layer list covers this otherwise)

showSidebar.description: Show the sidebar toggle for editing layer style, filters and SQL at runtime. On your own canvas the edits are written into this config as you make them (undo with Cmd/Ctrl+Z in the sidebar or the code editor); elsewhere they are runtime overrides you can copy into the config.

param.description: Canvas parameter name to sync viewport bounds [west, south, east, north]

autoSendDebounceMs.description: Debounce ms for auto-send (0 = send on every move)

clickParam.description: Canvas parameter that receives the properties of the last clicked feature

stateParam.description: Canvas parameter that mirrors the map's runtime state (camera, layer type, style, filters, SQL overrides) so other widgets can read it. It is saved with the canvas and restored on reload. On your own canvas layer edits are written into this config as you make them, so the parameter mostly carries the camera.

style.description: Inline CSS styles as a plain CSS string
